items.name: Pexo
items.tagline: Produce pitch perfect launch videos with precise control
items.description: Pexo makes creating your launch video as simple as having a conversation. Share your product, website, or assets. It plans the story, chooses the right AI model for each task, generates and assembles the scenes, and handles voiceover, music, captions, motion graphics, and editing. Leave a comment or circle what you want changed, and Pexo makes the edit. You direct one agent from idea to a finished, on-brand launch video.

items.name: Ferndesk
items.tagline: The help center that never goes out of date
items.description: Ferndesk is a complete help center with an agent that checks every article against your product, catches what changed, and drafts the fixes for you.

items.name: Autonomyware
items.tagline: Idea to physical product, engineer anything you can imagine
items.description: Autonomyware turns your idea into an engineered physical product. Start with your vision and let autonomous AI handle the engineering process end to end. Describe what you want to create, then move from product definition through architecture, risk, CAD, BOMs, code, verification, and manufacturing preparation. One AI-native workspace keeps every decision and engineering artifact connected from idea to implementation.

items.name: GitBot
items.tagline: Build bots on the coding agent you already use
items.description: GitBot turns a job you keep giving Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode into a bot. Write the instructions once, set what it may touch, and run it in any repo. Each run is a thread you can come back to. Install bots other devs made from the Library, or share yours with a code. ShipGuard, for example, reads your branch and says merge or block, with file and line evidence. Runs on your machine with the logins you already have. Open source. No account, no telemetry.

items.name: CrawlRaven MCP
items.tagline: Your SEO work, done from your AI agent
items.description: CrawlRaven joins Search Console, GA4, your keyword lists, and a technical crawl of your site into one plan, ranked by impact: what to fix, update and write first. Ask for it in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor through our MCP server and get answers from your own data.

items.name: OpenShip
items.tagline: Open source PaaS on your server or in the cloud. No lock in.
items.description: OpenShip is an open source PaaS that runs on our cloud or your infrastructure. Push your code and OpenShip handles builds, deployments, domains, SSL, monitoring, backups, secrets, and the services your apps depend on. Start fully managed on OpenShip Cloud or self host on your own cloud or on prem. Move between them without changing how you deploy. No proprietary runtime. No vendor lock in. Remove OpenShip and your apps keep running. Deploy anything. Own everything.

items.name: Macaly Cloud
items.tagline: Build and publish sites with your Claude or ChatGPT
items.description: Add Macaly Cloud to your Claude or ChatGPT and build websites and apps right from the chat. Macaly provides the database, hosting, domain and 70+ skills the code needs to go live, on the subscription you already pay for. Also works in Claude Code, Codex and Grok Bot.

items.name: jambuild
items.tagline: Near instant multiplayer vibecoding, just point and talk
items.description: A multiplayer vibecoding tool where you talk and point with your mouse, and every change lands in seconds. Has limited credits to try it out, and you can BYO API keys to unlock more usage.

items.name: NotchDodo
items.tagline: NotchDodo turns your notch into a full-blown dashboard.
items.description: NotchDodo turns your Mac’s notch into a useful part of your everyday workflow. 🦤 With 14 built-in tools, NotchDodo gives you quick access to handy utilities without interrupting your work. It’s lightweight, simple, and designed specifically for Macs with a notch. Instead of working around the notch, make it useful. 14 tools. One notch. A more useful Mac.

items.name: Aktar
items.tagline: Share files instantly from your own cloud. Mac, Windows, iOS
items.description: Aktar is a free, open-source app for instantly sharing files through your own S3-compatible storage. Drop a file and Aktar uploads it to S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO or similar storage, then copies the shareable link to your clipboard. Works with any file: screenshots, logs, builds, videos. No accounts, no intermediary servers, and your files stay in your own storage. Available on Mac, Windows and iOS, with Android coming soon.

items.name: lurk
items.tagline: Free, open-source Reddit and Twitter lead monitoring
items.description: lurk watches Reddit and X for people asking for a product like yours, scores each post with a one-line reason, and sends new ones to email, Slack, Discord or a webhook. Also finds the Reddit threads Google ranks for you. Free and open source.

items.name: Datastory
items.tagline: Turn the world's data into stories worth sharing
items.description: Datastory is the no-code platform for data storytellers. Create interactive charts, websites, and reports with AI, and access a growing catalog of open datasets.

items.name: Flocker Agent Profiles
items.tagline: Profile Pages for Agents: your live AI collaboration network
items.description: Never lose context again! Give your Agent a profile page, live feed, and personal storage. Access it anywhere, and connect more to build your private agent network. Give every agent a job title! AI works better with a clear job description. Log-in and ask your agent to create a new Agent Profile for self-managed context, collaborative agent workflows and task management. Works with all your favourite AI tools incl. Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and OpenClaw.

items.name: Upsolve Data Models
items.tagline: Teach AI your metric definitions and business vocabulary
items.description: Register your data model, metric definitions and business vocabulary once. Upsolve grounds every agent answer in them, versions them like code and refreshes column values nightly, so answers stay correct as your data changes.

items.name: CoIsland
items.tagline: Your whole engineering stack, in a notch
items.description: CoIsland watches CI, deploys, errors, incidents and databases (35+ connectors) and shows only what breaks, in an island on the edge of your Mac's screen. Monitors are plain SQL or shell files. One click hands an alert to Claude Code, Codex or Cortex Code.

items.name: Evlat
items.tagline: Know which AI coding agent is waiting on you
items.description: Evlat is a thin strip on your Mac's screen edge, one ring per Claude Code or Codex session. When one needs a permission or an answer, it turns amber; one click opens its terminal tab. It also tracks long commands and remote servers. Native, no permissions.

items.name: Bevell
items.tagline: CAD automation where it counts.
items.description: Stop redrawing parts by hand. Turn a photo, sketch, scan or PDF into a file you can cut, mill or print. Get an editable DXF and true-scale SVG. Preview unlimited conversions for free. Bevell Sketchpad now in beta.

items.name: m’kay
items.tagline: One voice for all your coding agents, from your phone
items.description: Talk to the AI agents on your Mac from any browser or phone. Other voice apps talk to one assistant. m’kay talks to all your agents: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on your Mac. Ask which one is done, hear its reply, and tell it what to do next from your phone's browser, on the train, or at the gym. It drives the real desktop apps, so your sessions and projects stay where they are. Nothing is sent until you say "yes" to a read-back. Open source: run it all locally, or use the menu-bar Mac app.

items.name: Bruto
items.tagline: A task board that lives in your repo, for you and your AI
items.description: A brutalist task board for coding with AI. Notes live in your repo: copy the context with one key, or let an agent work the board over MCP and answer in each note. Standing rules, cross-project links and a map of your pages, APIs and tables. Free, open source.

items.name: Agent Identity
items.tagline: Give every AI agent real identities, inboxes, and a phone
items.description: AI agents are starting to access APIs, databases, SaaS tools, and other agents but most identity infrastructure wasn't built for them. Agent Identity gives every agent a persistent identity, credentials, permissions, and an audit trail, so developers can control what their agents can access and what they do. Built for developers building real agentic systems.
